sections.title: Inviting someone by name
sections.content: *meghív* means 'to invite'. The person you invite is the object, so it gets the accusative *-t* and the verb takes the definite ending: *Meghívom Annát a buliba.* (I invite Anna to the party.) Names: *Anna → Annát*, *Károly → Károlyt*. You know *terv* (plan), as in *Van egy tervem.*

items.english: I invite Anna to the party.
I have a plan: I invite Anna.

sections.content: A name is a definite object, so use *meghívom*, not *meghívok*.
